inputs: A proposed change to org, permissions, employee contract or handoff shape
invariants: No session spawns subagents, child agents, worker swarms or nested delegations; multiple perspectives are separate sequential sessions (rule 2).
Production systems must not depend on company/; Company OS must be removable (rule 12).
A session is given the minimum relevant context, never the whole repository (rule 5).
Every change to code, org, prompts, employees or workflows must be reversible (rule 10).
Facts, hypotheses and decisions stay structurally distinct (rule 16).
A canonical fact is stored once and retrieved, not restated (rule 15).
Amending the no-subagent rule, the production permission model, the mission or a CEO-reserved decision requires explicit CEO approval.
outputs: An allow/deny answer, and the CEO-reserved decisions that need approval
purpose: The non-negotiable rules every Company OS session runs under, and the contracts that encode them. The files are the source of truth; this capsule is the pointer that stops a session re-reading all seven to find the four rules that bind it.
risks: An agent could restate a constitutional rule inside a capsule and drift from company/constitution.md; the file is the source, the capsule is a pointer.
title: Bootstrap operating policy
